test_name: Physical and Environmental Protection - PE-8 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Audit-Lake-105
Primary NIST family: Physical and Environmental Protection (PE); evidence focus: PE-8.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: production facilities use controlled entry, badges, and monitored restricted areas. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
